Heritage & Philosophy

The Art of Pure Vegetarian Dining

VT Chefs was born out of an uncompromising devotion to pure vegetarian fine dining. We believe that plant-based, dairy-rich, and artisanal Indian and world cuisines possess unmatched complexity, depth, and celebratory joy.

From age-old Kathiyawadi and Marwari wood-fire recipes to delicate Italian truffles and vibrant Mexican street-style salsas, every dish is executed with Michelin-grade discipline in your private kitchen.
